t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are four gnomes that work together, so you have to work out for each round which one of each pair gets the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: You'll find that there are four pairs of gnomes.They'll always be in the same pairs. You need to work out as quickly as possible which ones does the best. If the numbers go down with that gnome, immediately swap to the opposite gnome in the pair. You'll need to repeat this every new round as the gnome which does best will change each time.
